blocks.orig: The intimate Tarangire View Camp is located in Tarangire National Park in the shade of large acacia and sausage trees on the banks of a seasonal riverbed. The camp boasts 8 tents accommodating 1 to 4 people each. It offers a lovely safari bush experience on a breathtaking location and with a touch of comfort and privacy. The main tent is furnished with sofas to relax on, a small bar and tables for lovely dinners. From your private terrace, you can spot the occasional local wildlife passing by – think elephants, impalas, lions, jackals and leopards – and many bird species provide the perfect morning wake-up calls.
blocks.html: Inside Tarangire National Park, the intimate Tarangire View Camp sits beside a seasonal riverbed, shaded by large acacia and sausage trees. There are 8 tents in the camp, each sleeping 1 to 4 people. It gives you a lovely bush safari experience in a stunning setting, with a degree of comfort and privacy. In the main tent you will find sofas for relaxing, a small bar and tables for pleasant dinners. From your own terrace you may see local wildlife wander by now and then – elephants, impalas, lions, jackals and leopards, for example – while many bird species make for an ideal wake-up call in the morning.
